name: Detector de jugador cercano
description: Busca el jugador más cercano dentro de un radio configurable, sin mover ni afectar personajes.
code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local function nearestPlayer(origin, radius)
    local best, bestDistance = nil, radius
    for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            local distance = (root.Position - origin).Magnitude
            if distance < bestDistance then best, bestDistance = player, distance end
        end
    end
    return best, bestDistance
end
-- Ejemplo: local player, distance = nearestPlayer(Vector3.zero, 50)

compatibility.context: Busca el jugador más cercano dentro de un radio configurable, sin mover ni afectar personajes.

local cooldowns = {}

    local now = os.clock()
    if cooldowns[userId] and now - cooldowns[userId] < duration then
        return false
    end
    cooldowns[userId] = now
    return true
end

name: Tabla de niveles y experiencia
description: Calcula el nivel a partir de experiencia acumulada con una curva simple.
code:
local function levelFromXp(xp)
    assert(xp >= 0, "XP no puede ser negativa")
    local level, required = 1, 100
    while xp >= required do
        xp -= required
        level += 1
        required = math.floor(required * 1.25)
    end
    return level, xp, required
end
print(levelFromXp(450))

name: Medir tiempo con context manager
description: Crea un context manager reutilizable para medir duración.
code:
from contextlib import contextmanager
from time import perf_counter
@contextmanager
def timer(label):
    start = perf_counter()
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        print(f"{label}: {perf_counter() - start:.4f}s")
with timer("cálculo"):
    sum(range(1_000_000))
